title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff + regional circuit-breaker improvements to prevent load-shedding thrash
author: Ivy Chen
description: Root cause of INC-2026-02-23: aggressive SLO enforcer sensitivity combined with immediate regional circuit-breaker reopen attempts caused repeated cross-region failovers and excessive load-shedding. This hotfix reduces thrashing by (1) increasing the SLO enforcer aggregation window and adding an explicit cooldown before a second enforcement decision, (2) adding exponential backoff plus randomized jitter to regional circuit-breaker reopen logic, (3) capping rapid failover attempts via a configurable cooldown and backoff cap, (4) exposing a feature flag to rollout incrementally and enable safe rollbacks, and (5) adding telemetry and integration tests to validate behavior under synthetic regional outage scenarios. Includes tests, docs, and rollout plan. See linked Linear ENG-7821 and support ticket SUP-1990 for incident timeline and validation criteria.
commits: fix(slo): increase aggregation window to 60s and add cooldown token
fix(cb): implement exponential backoff + jitter for regional reopen path
test(integration): add e2e test for regional failover thrash scenario
chore(flag): add runtime feature flag slo_backoff.enable and rollout config
docs(release): add release notes and troubleshooting steps for SLO enforcer

Ivy Chen: Added test_regional_failover.py and adjusted cooldown cap to 120s in values.yaml (addresses Rohit's comment).
Samantha Lee: Can we add metrics for backoff count and cooldown duration so SRE can alert on thrashing?
Ivy Chen: Added rbc_backoff_count and rbc_cooldown_ms metrics and updated dashboard JSON. Ready for final review.
Diego Alvarez: Verified local e2e and unit runs, CI flaky unit test fixed by test isolation; approving.
release_notes: Hotfix: Reduce SLO enforcer sensitivity and add exponential backoff + jitter to regional circuit-breaker reopen logic to prevent repeated cross-region failovers and excessive load-shedding. Includes new telemetry and an integration test. Rollout via feature flag 'slo_backoff.enable' (default off).
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Changes are guarded by feature flag and configurable knobs. Backoff defaults conservative; observable metrics and dashboard added for fast rollback if needed.
summary: Hotfix to prevent regional failover thrashing by improving SLO enforcement and introducing exponential backoff/cooldown to regional circuit-breakers.
